{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_03","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_03 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. arguments.query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), amounts AS arguments.query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00') AND date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), totals AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='payment' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS payments,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='credit' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS credits,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='hold' AND status='active' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS holds FROM active WHERE kind IN ('payment','credit','hold') GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.amount_minor,COALESCE(a.payments,0) AS payments,COALESCE(a.credits,0) AS credits,COALESCE(a.holds,0) AS holds,i.discount_until,t.business_date AS terms_date,t.discount_bps,f.business_date AS fx_date,f.fx_num,f.fx_den FROM active i LEFT JOIN totals a ON a.invoice_id=i.event_key LEFT JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date=(SELECT MAX(t2.business_date) FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) LEFT JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date=(SELECT MAX(f2.business_date) FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.currency=i.currency AND date(f2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND date(i.due_date)<=date('2026-10-30') ORDER BY i.event_key

Add shipping_cents unless the PRE-DISCOUNT gross >= free_shipping_gross. Subtract rebate_cents only if at least two different SKUs are selected from that vendor AND the POST-DISCOUNT merchandise total >= rebate_merchandise_min. All thresholds are inclusive. Total cost is the sum over all vendors used. Find the globally minimum total cost in cents, not the result of a greedy per-SKU choice. arguments.code:
vendors = {v['id']: v for v in data['vendors']}
skus = sorted(data['skus'])
options = [[q for q in data['quotes'] if q['sku'] == s and data['skus'][s]['demand'] <= q['units'] <= data['skus'][s]['demand'] + 2 and q['arrival'] <= data['skus'][s]['deadline'] and q['quality'] == 'approved'] for s in skus]
best = None
best_ids = None
feasible = 0
for combo in itertools.product(*options):
    selected = {q['sku']: q for q in combo}
    used = set(q['vendor'] for q in combo)
    if len(used) < 3 or sum(q['carbon'] for q in combo) > data['carbon_cap']:
        continue
    if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and selected[q['needs_same_vendor_sku']]['vendor'] != q['vendor'] for q in combo):
        continue
    total = 0
    valid = True
    for vid in used:
        v = vendors[vid]
        lots = [q for q in combo if q['vendor'] == vid]
        units = sum(q['units'] for q in lots)
        if units > v['unit_cap']:
            valid = False
            break
        gross = sum(q['units'] * q['unit_cents'] for q in lots)
        bps = v['tier_bps'] if units >= v['tier_units'] else 0
        merchandise = (gross * (10000 - bps) + 5000) // 10000
        shipping = v['shipping_cents'] if gross < v['free_shipping_gross'] else 0
        rebate = v['rebate_cents'] if len(set(q['sku'] for q in lots)) >= 2 and merchandise >= v['rebate_merchandise_min'] else 0
        total += merchandise + shipping - rebate
    if valid:
        feasible += 1
        if best is None or total < best:
            best = total
            best_ids = [q['id'] for q in combo]
print({'options': [[q['id'] for q in opts] for opts in options], 'feasible': feasible, 'minimum_cents': best, 'selection': best_ids})

arguments.query:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn
  FROM ledger
  WHERE date(business_date) <= date('2026-10-23')
    AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')
), active AS (
  SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE rn = 1 AND status <> 'void'
), invoices AS (
  SELECT * FROM active
  WHERE kind = 'invoice' AND vendor = 'BLUE' AND date(due_date) <= date('2026-10-30')
), per_invoice AS (
  SELECT i.event_key,
    MAX(0, i.amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)
                         - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS held,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(t.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_until FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(t.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1),'') AS discount_until,
    COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND date(f.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1),1) AS fx_num,
    COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND date(f.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1),1) AS fx_den
  FROM invoices i
), amounts AS (
  SELECT MAX(0, remaining-held) AS unheld, discount_bps, discount_until, fx_num, fx_den FROM per_invoice
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(((unheld * CASE WHEN date('2026-10-23') <= date(discount_until) THEN (10000-discount_bps) ELSE 10000 END) * fx_num * 2.0 / (10000.0 * fx_den)) + 0.5 AS INTEGER)) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM amounts WHERE unheld >= 0

import json,itertools,collections,datetime
w=json.loads(context)
qs=w['quotes']; skus=w['skus']; vinfo={v['id']:v for v in w['vendors']}
opts={s:[q for q in qs if q['sku']==s and q['quality']=='approved' and q['units']>=skus[s]['demand'] and q['units']<=skus[s]['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=skus[s]['deadline']] for s in skus}
best=None
for sel in itertools.product(*(opts[s] for s in skus)):
    by=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for q in sel: by[q['vendor']].append(q)
    if len(by)<3: continue
    carbon=sum(q['carbon'] for q in sel)
    if carbon>w['carbon_cap']: continue
    if any(sum(q['units'] for q in arr)>vinfo[v]['unit_cap'] for v,arr in by.items()): continue
    good=True
    for q in sel:
        other=q['needs_same_vendor_sku']
        if other and next(x for x in sel if x['sku']==other)['vendor']!=q['vendor']: good=False; break
    if not good: continue
    total=0
    for v,arr in by.items():
        info=vinfo[v]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in arr); gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in arr)
        # round half up on integer cents after applying basis points
        merch=(gross*(10000-info['tier_bps'])+5000)//10000 if units>=info['tier_units'] else gross
        cost=merch+(0 if gross>=info['free_shipping_gross'] else info['shipping_cents'])
        if len({q['sku'] for q in arr})>=2 and merch>=info['rebate_merchandise_min']: cost-=info['rebate_cents']
        total+=cost
    if best is None or total<best[0]: best=(total,sel)
print(FINAL(str(best[0])) if best else 'no feasible selection')

import itertools
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date
skus=data['skus']; vendors={v['id']:v for v in data['vendors']}
opts=[]
for sku,info in skus.items():
    opts.append([q for q in data['quotes'] if q['sku']==sku and q['quality']=='approved' and q['units']>=info['demand'] and q['units']<=info['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=info['deadline']])
best=None; bestset=None
for sel in itertools.product(*opts):
    if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and next((x['vendor'] for x in sel if x['sku']==q['needs_same_vendor_sku']),None)!=q['vendor'] for q in sel): continue
    if sum(q['carbon'] for q in sel)>data['carbon_cap']: continue
    by=defaultdict(list)
    for q in sel: by[q['vendor']].append(q)
    if len(by)<3 or any(sum(q['units'] for q in qs)>vendors[v]['unit_cap'] for v,qs in by.items()): continue
    total=0
    for v,qs in by.items():
        cfg=vendors[v]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in qs); gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in qs)
        merch=(gross*(10000-cfg['tier_bps'])+5000)//10000 if units>=cfg['tier_units'] else gross
        cost=merch+(0 if gross>=cfg['free_shipping_gross'] else cfg['shipping_cents'])
        if len({q['sku'] for q in qs})>=2 and merch>=cfg['rebate_merchandise_min']: cost-=cfg['rebate_cents']
        total+=cost
    if best is None or total<best:
        best=total; bestset=sel
print(best, [q['id'] for q in bestset])
print(FINAL(str(best)) )

All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. arguments.query: WITH eligible AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00')), latest AS (SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE rn = 1 AND status <> 'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE kind = 'invoice' AND vendor = 'BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key AS invoice_id, MAX(0, i.amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM latest p WHERE p.kind = 'payment' AND p.invoice_id = i.event_key), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM latest c WHERE c.kind = 'credit' AND c.invoice_id = i.event_key), 0)) AS remaining, i.discount_until, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM latest h WHERE h.kind = 'hold' AND h.invoice_id = i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')), 0) AS held, COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM latest t WHERE t.kind = 'terms' AND t.terms_code = i.terms_code AND t.business_date <= i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS discount_bps, COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_num FROM latest f WHERE f.kind = 'fx' AND f.currency = i.currency AND f.business_date <= i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1), 1) AS fx_num, COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_den FROM latest f WHERE f.kind = 'fx' AND f.currency = i.currency AND f.business_date <= i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1), 1) AS fx_den FROM invoices i), exact AS (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(0, remaining - held) AS unheld, CASE WHEN discount_until >= '2026-10-23' THEN 10000-discount_bps ELSE 10000 END AS disc_factor, fx_num, fx_den FROM calc), amounts AS (SELECT invoice_id, CAST((unheld * disc_factor * fx_num * 2 + 10000 * fx_den) / (2 * 10000 * fx_den) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM exact) SELECT invoice_id, usd_cents, (SELECT SUM(usd_cents) FROM amounts) AS total_usd_cents FROM amounts WHERE invoice_id IS NOT NULL

import json,itertools,datetime
w=json.loads(context)
qs=w['quotes']; skus=w['skus']; vendors={v['id']:v for v in w['vendors']}
opts=[]
for s,info in skus.items():
 opts.append([q for q in qs if q['sku']==s and q['quality']=='approved' and q['units']>=info['demand'] and q['units']<=info['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=info['deadline']])
best=None; bestset=None
for chosen in itertools.product(*opts):
 if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and next(x for x in chosen if x['sku']==q['needs_same_vendor_sku'])['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in chosen): continue
 if sum(q['carbon'] for q in chosen)>w['carbon_cap']: continue
 used={}
 for q in chosen: used.setdefault(q['vendor'],[]).append(q)
 if len(used)<3 or any(sum(q['units'] for q in group)>vendors[v]['unit_cap'] for v,group in used.items()): continue
 total=0
 for v,group in used.items():
  rule=vendors[v]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in group); gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in group)
  merch=(gross*(10000-rule['tier_bps'])+5000)//10000 if units>=rule['tier_units'] else gross
  subtotal=merch+(0 if gross>=rule['free_shipping_gross'] else rule['shipping_cents'])
  if len(set(q['sku'] for q in group))>=2 and merch>=rule['rebate_merchandise_min']: subtotal-=rule['rebate_cents']
  total+=subtotal
 if best is None or total<best: best,bestset=total,chosen
print(best,bestset)
print(FINAL(str(best)))

arguments.query:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT * FROM ledger
  WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23'
    AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn
  FROM eligible
), active AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status <> 'void'
), invoices AS (
  SELECT * FROM active
  WHERE kind = 'invoice' AND vendor = 'BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'
), amounts AS (
  SELECT i.event_key, i.amount_minor AS gross,
    MAX(0, i.amount_minor
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_until FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),'') AS discount_until,
    (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_num,
    (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den
  FROM invoices i
), final AS (
 SELECT event_key,
   MAX(0, remaining-holds) AS unheld,
   CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN MAX(0, remaining-holds)*(10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE MAX(0, remaining-holds) END AS discounted,
   fx_num, fx_den,
   CAST((CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN MAX(0, remaining-holds)*(10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE MAX(0, remaining-holds) END)*fx_num/fx_den + 0.5 AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents
 FROM amounts WHERE fx_num IS NOT NULL AND fx_den <> 0
)
SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents
FROM final WHERE event_key IS NOT NULL

  SELECT * FROM ledger
  WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23'

), amounts AS (

      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,

    (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_num,
    (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den
  FROM invoices i
), final AS (
 SELECT event_key,
   MAX(0, remaining-holds) AS unheld,
   CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN MAX(0, remaining-holds)*(10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE MAX(0, remaining-holds) END AS discounted,
   fx_num, fx_den,
   CAST((CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN MAX(0, remaining-holds)*(10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE MAX(0, remaining-holds) END)*fx_num/fx_den + 0.5 AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents
 FROM amounts WHERE fx_num IS NOT NULL AND fx_den <> 0
)
SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents
FROM final WHERE event_key IS NOT NULL"}}

arguments.query:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den
  FROM ledger
  WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23'
    AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')
), ranked AS (
  SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn
  FROM eligible
), active AS (
  SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den
  FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'
), invoices AS (
  SELECT event_key,amount_minor,currency,business_date,terms_code
  FROM active
  WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date<='2026-10-30'
), calc AS (
  SELECT i.event_key,
    MAX(0,i.amount_minor
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,
    COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_until FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),'') AS discount_until,
    (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_num,
    (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den
  FROM invoices i
), per_invoice AS (
  SELECT event_key,
    CAST((MAX(0,remaining-holds)
      * CASE WHEN '2026-10-23'<=discount_until THEN 10000-discount_bps ELSE 10000 END
      * fx_num * 2
      + 10000*fx_den)
      /(2.0*10000*fx_den) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents
  FROM calc WHERE fx_num IS NOT NULL AND fx_den>0
)
SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents FROM per_invoice WHERE event_key IS NOT NULL

f.currency=i.currency AND date(f.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den FROM invoices i), amounts AS (SELECT *, MAX(0,gross-payments-credits) AS 10000*fx_den)/(2*10000*fx_den) AS usd_cents FROM final WHERE fx_num IS NOT NULL AND fx_den IS NOT NULL

vendors = {v['id']: v for v in data['vendors']}
skus = sorted(data['skus'])
options = []
for sku in skus:
    rule = data['skus'][sku]
    options.append([q for q in data['quotes'] if q['sku'] == sku and rule['demand'] <= q['units'] <= rule['demand'] + 2 and q['arrival'] <= rule['deadline'] and q['quality'] == 'approved'])
best = None
best_ids = None
feasible = 0
for chosen in itertools.product(*options):
    used = set(q['vendor'] for q in chosen)
    if len(used) < 3 or sum(q['carbon'] for q in chosen) > data['carbon_cap']:
        continue
    selected = {q['sku']: q for q in chosen}
    if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and selected[q['needs_same_vendor_sku']]['vendor'] != q['vendor'] for q in chosen):
        continue
    total = 0
    valid = True
    for vendor_id in used:
        vendor = vendors[vendor_id]
        lots = [q for q in chosen if q['vendor'] == vendor_id]
        units = sum(q['units'] for q in lots)
        if units > vendor['unit_cap']:
            valid = False
            break
        gross = sum(q['units'] * q['unit_cents'] for q in lots)
        bps = vendor['tier_bps'] if units >= vendor['tier_units'] else 0
        merchandise = (gross * (10000 - bps) + 5000) // 10000
        cost = merchandise
        if gross < vendor['free_shipping_gross']:
            cost += vendor['shipping_cents']
        if len(set(q['sku'] for q in lots)) >= 2 and merchandise >= vendor['rebate_merchandise_min']:
            cost -= vendor['rebate_cents']
        total += cost
    if valid:
        feasible += 1
        if best is None or total < best:
            best = total
            best_ids = [q['id'] for q in chosen]
print({'minimum': best, 'quotes': best_ids, 'feasible_combinations': feasible})
print(FINAL(str(best)))

Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_05 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. arguments.query: WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23') AND datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00')), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) rn FROM eligible), active AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND date(due_date)<=date('2026-10-30')), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key, MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) remaining, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) holds, COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t.business_date)<=date(i.business_date) ORDER BY date(t.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1),0) discount_bps, COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_until FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_05 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). date(t.business_date) DESC) AS rn FROM invoices i JOIN active t ON t.kind = 'terms' AND t.terms_code = i.terms_code AND date(t.business_date) <= date(i.business_date)), fx_ranked AS (SELECT i.event_key AS inv_key, f.fx_num, f.fx_den, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.event_key ORDER BY date(f.business_date) DESC) AS rn FROM invoices i JOIN active f ON f.kind = 'fx' AND f.currency = WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT kind, event_key, invoice_id, vendor, business_date, recorded_at, revision, status, amount_minor, currency, due_date, discount_until, terms_code, discount_bps, fx_num, fx_den,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn
  FROM ledger
  WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23'
    AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00')
), active AS (
  SELECT kind, event_key, invoice_id, vendor, business_date, status, amount_minor, currency, due_date, discount_until, terms_code, discount_bps, fx_num, fx_den
  FROM scoped
  WHERE rn = 1 AND status <> 'void'
), invoices AS (
  SELECT event_key AS invoice_id, business_date, amount_minor, currency, due_date, discount_until, terms_code
  FROM active
  WHERE kind = 'invoice' AND vendor = 'BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'
), reductions AS (
  SELECT invoice_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('payment','credit') THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS paid_credited,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'hold' AND status NOT IN ('release','void') THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS held
  FROM active
  WHERE kind IN ('payment','credit','hold')
  GROUP BY invoice_id
), priced AS (
  SELECT i.invoice_id,
         MAX(0, MAX(0, i.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.paid_credited, 0)) - COALESCE(r.held, 0)) AS unheld,
         CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= i.discount_until THEN t.discount_bps ELSE 0 END AS discount_bps,
         f.fx_num, f.fx_den
  FROM invoices i
  LEFT JOIN reductions r ON r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
  JOIN active t ON t.kind = 'terms' AND t.status = 'active' AND t.terms_code = i.terms_code
                AND t.business_date = (SELECT MAX(t2.business_date) FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind = 'terms' AND t2.status = 'active' AND t2.terms_code = i.terms_code AND t2.business_date <= i.business_date)
  JOIN active f ON f.kind = 'fx' AND f.status = 'active' AND f.currency = i.currency
